SELECT 
    product_id,
    SUM(pick_qty) as total_picked
FROM (
    WITH order_lines AS (
        SELECT 
            id,
            order_id,
            product_id,
            qty,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) as line_seq,
            SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY id) as product_cumulative_qty
        FROM orderlines
        WHERE order_id = 423
    ),
    product_totals AS (
        SELECT 
            product_id,
            MAX(product_cumulative_qty) as total_needed
        FROM order_lines
        GROUP BY product_id
    ),
    inv_sorted AS (
        SELECT 
            i.product_id,
            i.location_id,
            l.aisle,
            l.position,
            i.qty as available_qty,
            p.purchased,
            i.purchase_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty) as inv_seq
        FROM inventory i
        JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
        JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
        WHERE l.warehouse = 1
          AND i.product_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM orderlines WHERE order_id = 423)
    ),
    with_cumulative AS (
        SELECT 
            pt.product_id,
            i.location_id,
            i.aisle,
            i.position,
            i.available_qty,
            i.inv_seq,
            i.purchased,
            pt.total_needed,
            SUM(i.available_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.product_id ORDER BY i.inv_seq) as cumulative_available
        FROM product_totals pt
        JOIN inv_sorted i ON pt.product_id = i.product_id
    ),
    with_pick_qty AS (
        SELECT 
            product_id,
            location_id,
            aisle,
            position,
            available_qty,
            inv_seq,
            purchased,
            total_needed,
            cumulative_available,
            LEAST(available_qty, total_needed - COALESCE(LAG(cumulative_available) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY inv_seq), 0)) as calc_pick_qty
        FROM with_cumulative
    ),
    final_pick AS (
        SELECT 
            product_id,
            aisle,
            position,
            calc_pick_qty as pick_qty
        FROM with_pick_qty
        WHERE calc_pick_qty > 0
    )
    SELECT * FROM final_pick
) t
GROUP BY product_id
